newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST - France's Paribas ups Danish 96 GDP growth.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - France's Paribas ups Danish 96 GDP growth.

text.p: In its latest survey France's Paribas Capital Markets on Monday upped its expectations for Denmark's 1996 GDP (gross domestic product) growth to 1.6 percent from 1.5 percent in March.
At the same time it left unchanged its 1996 forecasts for inflation at 2.2 percent and the current account surplus at 17.7 billion crowns.

The latest Danish Economy Ministry forecast in August foresaw 1.8 percent GDP growth, 2.0 percent inflation, 9.0 percent unemployment and a current account surplus of 10.0 billion crowns for this year.
The following estimates were made by 10 leading local and international organisations.
